svg.title: JagSi software testing tools
svg.desc: Five testing areas with the tools used and the behavior checked.
svg.text: From simulated sensor readings to caregiver actions

g.text: Wokwi ESP32 simulator · Python MQTT monitor
Adjust simulated heart rate, SpO₂ and temperature. Compare the MQTT payload, API responseand dashboard value. Send set_interval and measure the change in publishing cadence.
Use fixtures to check invalid payloads and device IDs. Send a known sequence, restart the mirrorand compare stored records to catch gaps or duplicates. Use a separate demo database.
scikit-learn evaluation scripts · Wokwi SOS button
Replay labeled falls and ordinary movements such as sitting or lying down. Count missed fallsand false alarms. Press SOS separately and verify that the app shows the correct event source.
Acknowledge an alert in one browser tab and check the second tab and event log after refresh.Stop and resume the Wokwi stream to verify stale status and recovery.
Feed 60 readings with a known trend. Compare the summary with the model result and sourcereadings. Ask the chatbot a question about available data and verify its answer against the fixture.

svg.text: Scope: simulated inputs. Physical sensor accuracy needs separate testing.
